title: Give each hand a job
summary: One hand chooses the sound; the other starts it.

steps.title: Give each hand a job
steps.body:
**fretting hand** means the hand that presses strings along the neck

**Why it matters:** It chooses the sound you want.

**picking hand** means the hand that starts a string vibrating near the body

**Why it matters:** It starts the sound.

On a usual right-handed setup, the left hand is the fretting hand and the right hand is the picking hand. A left-handed setup can reverse this. The jobs matter more than left and right.

steps.title: Look and listen
steps.body: Touch the neck lightly with your fretting hand. Hover your picking hand over the strings near the body. No pressing or playing is needed yet.

items.prompt: Which hand starts the string vibrating near the body?

steps.title: Take your time
steps.body: Swap between pointing to your fretting hand and your picking hand. Keep both wrists comfortable.
